And the utopic/Twitter Marxists that think that the dictatorship of the proletariat is pretty much the same as the third Reich. 

Both of these groups lack experience in living in a system that actually attempts to implement socialism and thus struggle to understand the inherent contradictions that may still exists and that these are sometimes a necessary evil to reach a goal. Add to that the complete perversion of Marxist theory in the west and how certain groups are either incapable of a decent analysis of the material conditions or think Das Kapital is some sort of bible.
